statement.zh: 将新干大洋洲简单定为中原商王国直接统治下的「方国都邑」，证据不足；宜保持区域青铜传统对照。
statement.en: Treating Xingan Dayangzhou simply as a Shang-kingdom vassal capital under direct Central Plains rule overreaches; keep it as a regional bronze-tradition peer.

disclaimer: Hypothesis / scholarly model — not established fact. Labelled kind=hypothesis.
